description: Source code implementing thread-based timer management and aggregation for tracing, including start/stop/update/emit functions for timers, with metadata definitions and external dependencies.

methods.name: tr2_start_timer
methods.description: Starts a timer for a given timer ID, handling recursion and recording start time.

methods.name: tr2_stop_timer
methods.description: Stops a timer, calculates interval, updates min/max/total, and flags usage.

methods.name: tr2_update_final_timers
methods.description: Aggregates thread-local timer data into a final global timer block.

methods.name: tr2_emit_per_thread_timers
methods.description: Emits per-thread timer data if applicable.
